pages.text: Tier 3 bosses are the most varied in the pack. Meet Your Fight superbosses, Cataclysm ultra-bosses, the Cardinal Sins ladder, vanilla Wither and Warden all live here. Full diamond gear is the minimum; Terrasteel or Enderium recommended.$(br2)The Cardinal Sins end in $(bold)Lucifer$(), the Tier 3 combat capstone: defeating him — or clearing 100% of the Tier 3 boss rush — opens Tier 4.

$(bold)Meet Your Fight$() — 4 superbosses in specialized biomes:$(br)Swampjaw → $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Harbinger$(/l) (18%)$(br)Bellringer → $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Hearthflame$(/l) (18%)$(br)Dame Fortuna → $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Magiscythe$(/l) (18%)$(br)Rosalyne → $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Magispear$(/l) (18%)$(br2)$(bold)Wither$() — Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Soulkeeper$(/l) (15%), Wither Bone, Ancient Debris peek.

$(bold)Cataclysm Bosses$()$(br)Netherite Monstrosity, Ignis, The Harbinger, The Leviathan, Maledictus — 5 ultra-bosses in massive Cataclysm structures. Each drops a unique weapon and boss material. The hardest T3 content.$(br2)$(bold)Warden$() (Vanilla)$(br)Deep Dark. Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Stormbringer$(/l) (20%).
